_comment_usage: Drop this on the us-east-2 relay host, fill in real destination IPs, rename to pkrelay_config.json. Symbols should be the UNION of what any Tokyo consumer needs — each consumer filters to its own RelayDBCME.symbols locally.
_comment_destinations: MUST be PRIVATE IPs of the Tokyo consumer EC2s (e.g. 172.31.x.x or 10.x.x.x). Public IPs would send packets over the public internet and defeat the relay's whole point — VPC peering only routes traffic between private addresses. See DEPLOY.md for the private-IP lookup steps.
